projects.name: ABC Tech Park — Demo Project
projects.siteNotes: 3-storey commercial office facility slated for redevelopment. Rich architectural interior with intact hardwood panel doors, double-glazed aluminium perimeter windows, heavy structural mezzanine framing, and high-spec electrical infrastructure.

recovery_items.notes: 34 salvageable door leafs recovered; 5 suffered edge splintering during expedited jamb detachment.
High shatter rate (18 units damaged) caused by early heavy vibration from northern bay demo.
High recovery yield using cold flame-cutting and crane rigging.

recovery_items.itemName: Commercial LED Luminares & Copper Distribution Cabling
recovery_items.notes: Subcontractor crew skipped conduit pull-out on floor 3 due to compressed schedule.
Impact shock from adjacent jackhammering broke 15 washbasins prior to de-plumbing.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Careful Deconstruction of Reusable Architectural Doors
recovery_sequences.justification: Soft-strip prior to mechanical shock and weather exposure preserves 90%+ resale value.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: High moisture and impact hazard if walls are penetrated before door leaf salvage.

recovery_sequences.justification: Remove glass panels from exterior envelope before structural vibration starts.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Vibrations from heavy equipment cause window glass to shatter, forfeiting salvage value.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: De-energize & Recover Copper Wiring & Modular Lighting
recovery_sequences.justification: Systematic electrical trace-and-pull yields clean, high-grade copper scrap and reusable fixtures.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Once gypsum drywall is crushed, copper recovery costs exceed market value.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Unbolt & Rig Structural Steel Mezzanines & Trusses
recovery_sequences.justification: Cold unfastening preserves structural integrity for direct secondary reuse.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Hydraulic shearing converts high-value beam sections into commodity scrap.

recovery_sequences.justification: Shut valves and disconnect porcelain assets before slab penetration.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Brittle porcelain shatters instantaneously under heavy equipment movements.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Initiate Heavy Mechanical Demolition & Masonry Processing
recovery_sequences.justification: Bulk concrete crushing and rubble sorting proceeds with zero contamination from soft assets.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Soft-strip Reusable Timber Doors & Architectural Wood
recovery_sequences.justification: Remove intact architectural wood before vibration or structural breach.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: High risk of surface splitting, warping, and contamination from subsequent masonry work.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Dismantle Aluminium Window Glazing & Perimeter Frames
recovery_sequences.justification: Extract exterior panels prior to internal ceiling and duct dismantling.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Vibrations and falling debris cause shatter rates to escalate dramatically.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Isolate & Recover Copper Cabling & Lighting Units
recovery_sequences.justification: De-energize circuits and deconstruct conduit runs safely.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Crushed drywall renders wire pull recovery cost-prohibitive.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Selective Deconstruction of Structural Steel & Sections
recovery_sequences.justification: Cold unbolting and crane rigging for intact secondary beam recovery.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Indiscriminate hydraulic shearing twists high-value structural profiles into low-grade scrap.

recovery_sequences.justification: Remove ceramics prior to slab collapse.
recovery_sequences.riskIfDelayed: Brittle porcelain exhibits near-100% loss rate under impact.

recovery_sequences.actionTitle: Commence Heavy Mechanical Demolition & Masonry Crushing
recovery_sequences.justification: Execute bulk concrete pulverizing and rebar separation only after soft-strip is verified.

itemCalculations.itemName: Commercial LED Luminares & Copper Distribution Cabling

project_ledgers.aiRootCauseSummary: Operational sequence overlap: Mechanical excavators initiated bay vibration before Floor 2 glazing and Floor 3 electrical extraction had concluded, resulting in ₹1,82,450 lost recovery value.
project_ledgers.aiCounterfactualRecommendation: Simulations demonstrate that strictly gating heavy excavator entry behind complete soft-strip would have preserved an additional 23% of glazing and salvaged 35 extra electrical fixtures.
